summary: Implemented deterministic offline multi-scenario paper lifecycle replay. The command runs fixture scenarios through intake, scoring, review, paper order planning, paper execution ledger generation, and per-scenario portfolio/exposure summaries for filled win, filled loss, not-filled, open position, settled position, rejected raw market, and no-action outcomes.
limitations: Fixture-only replay scenarios; no live markets, prices, APIs, or external metadata are fetched.
Each scenario composes existing offline lifecycle components without runtime wiring.
Paper fills, no-fills, open status, settlement, and PnL are deterministic local calculations only.
No runtime integration, dispatcher/run_codex, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, real orders, live trading, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-013: add offline lifecycle regression gates that fail if required replay scenario outcomes or locked safety flags change.
